sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-quick3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 26 / #25; Internal Quality Checks row 26; Deterministic Checks C28 for context)
evidence: All five dimension prompts open line 1 with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1), and every judge.toml declares the playwright MCP server (playwright-mcp --headless --isolated, chromium) under [[judge.mcp_servers]]; functional additionally wires the verifier restart_mcp.py server. Source/memory scoring is excluded: render says 'Use only rendered browser behavior' (render/prompt.md:1); constraints says 'Use only rendered browser behavior and the live DOM' and to decide the DOM criterion 'not from file names, bundled library names or how the code looks' (constraints/prompt.md:1,5); functional:22, polish:19 and visual:20 say 'do not read implementation files'; functional:11 and polish:11 require evidence 'you gathered yourself in this session'; visual:13-15 requires scoring from screenshots observed in-session at 1440x900. First-paint guessing is excluded: the render criterion requires a reload (render/judge.toml cw_workspace_loads_and_reloads); scored prompts restate a live-browser gate (functional:5, polish:5, visual:5); visual:14 requires typing a ten-line draft, Running it, observing the caret and making a selection before any screenshot scoring. All 55 criteria (2 constraints, 1 render, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) are written as real-key/mouse interactions or live DOM/computed-style/screenshot reads; the only non-browser tool is restart_app, which is bounded to cw_save_reload_restart and followed by fresh-page re-reads (functional:33). app_context.md:18-31 supports feasibility with a custom/canvas editor (real keyboard via press-key or page.keyboard, screenshots for canvas colours), so a conforming non-DOM editor is not pushed to source reading. Counterexample attempts: a source-only or static-shell app cannot be credited because every criterion demands an in-session observed outcome and evidence discipline fails unperformed steps; a conforming canvas-drawn editor does not fail for lack of computed styles (app_context.md:31, cw_js_semantic_coloring allows screenshots). Structure matches the frozen template's functional prompt opening. Runtime note: no raw-evidence-index.json exists in this run directory, so actual judge tool-use transcripts were not inspected; this row grades prompt direction, which is fully determined by the frozen text, so the missing run is recorded as NOT EXERCISED rather than as a defect.
